summary.intent: Get the failing dependabot PR #367 (Storybook 11 alpha.8 and @napi-rs/cli bump) fixed and passing CI, by delegating the fix to a subagent and verifying the result.
summary.outcome: The subagent pushed signed fix 3524f269 to provider.ts, with local gates passing. The assistant confirmed the fix survived a main merge (head 7aae591b), but CI on the new head is mostly queued or running, so #367 is not yet confirmed green.

repo: Storybook 11 alpha.8 changed CsfFile: `_file` is gone, and createMetaComponentResolver now reads `csf.editor` and `csf.program`. `extractDescription` now takes `(node, editor: SourceEditor)`.

The repo's local gates are `just lint doc-check machete typos` and `just test-integration`. The integration run needs the native binding built, and building it modifies `packages/napi/binding.d.ts` and `index.js`, which must be reverted before committing.

CI has 16 non-Entire-Gates checks: Audit, Changesets, Coverage, four Install jobs (Node 24/26 x npm/pnpm), Lint, MSRV, SemVer, Test / Native binding crate, Test / Python scripts, Test / Rust, Test / TypeScript on Node 24 and 26, and Test / Vite plugin on the native binding.

@napi-rs/cli 3.10.8 to 3.10.9 does not affect the x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu non-cross build path. Its changes cover a powerpc64 to ppc64 mapping, `cargoTargetTriple` for the cross-compile filter, `-x` rejecting .json target specs, and spawn-error handling.

code.finding: Synthetic CsfFile objects now use `editor: csf.editor, program: csf.program` instead of `_file: csf._file`, and `csf.editor` is passed as the second argument to `extractDescription`. The original tsc errors were at lines 131, 150 and 200.

workflow: Dependabot branches can be updated underneath you, so check that a pushed fix is still in the new head's history. Here the head moved from 3524f269 to 7aae591b after a main merge, and the fix survived.
A subagent's report of a fix is not proof of green CI. Re-poll the PR checks yourself before calling the work done.
The subagent reported that it diffed the @napi-rs/cli packages, but it only read `createArtifactDestinationName` in 3.10.9 and did not diff it against 3.10.8. Treat that claim as partly unverified.

friction: CI runners were heavily backlogged. The new run (42146463300) sat queued about 20 minutes with no jobs started, and most checks were still queued on the later head.
The subagent could not confirm CI before handing back, since all 16 checks were pending at its last poll.
The branch head changed mid-session (97a0a100, then 3524f269, then 7aae591b), which forced a re-check that the fix was still present.
Building the native binding for integration tests dirtied tracked files, so they had to be reverted by hand.
